status: master screenplay and bible in development
purpose: Retell the documented story of Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr and the Williams–Buckler family in a complete source-led documentary, preserving contradictions and inconvenient material.

scene_policy.sequence: master-script order; one scene at a time

existing_scripts.policy: Preserve and audit existing scripts/cuts before materially revising or recreating.

versioning.patch: Correction, grade, mix, subtitle or continuity refinement

evidence_rules: Every factual beat links to artifact and source location.
Distinguish record, testimony, official account, interpretation, inference and legal contention.
Retain counterevidence and material that weakens a theory.
Never present generated dialogue or reconstruction as archival record.
